column2: śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ hariḥ oṃ agnim īḷe puraḥhitam yajñasya devam
indravāyū iti ime sutāḥ upa prayaḥbhiḥ ā gatam indavaḥ vām uśanti
upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ sute dadhiṣva naḥ canaḥ omāsaḥ
uta naḥ subhagān ariḥ voceyuḥ dasma kṛṣṭayaḥ syāma it
ya sukrato iti sukrato ā tvā viśantu āśavaḥ
indreṇa sam hi dṛkṣase samjagmānaḥ abibhyuṣā mandū iti
yūthāiva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīḥ iyarti ojasā īśānaḥ
dāśuṣe eva hi te vibhūtayaḥ ūtayaḥ indra māvate sadyaḥ
gmiyam homa gantāram ūtaye sutesute niokase bṛhat
vām apa vrajam vṛdhi kṛṇuṣva rādhaḥ adrivaḥ nahi tvā rodasī
bhinduḥ yuvā kaviḥ amitaojāḥ ajāyata indraḥ
vaḥ prati sma riṣataḥ daha agne tvam rakṣasvinaḥ agninā
devān īḷitaḥ ā vaha asi hotā manuḥhitaḥ stṛṇīta
trā agnim pūṣaṇam bhagam ādityān mārutam gaṇam pra vaḥ
ṛtunā potrāt yajñam punītana yūyam hi sudānavaḥ abhi
taye indra tvā sūracakṣasaḥ imāḥ dhānāḥ ghṛtasnuvaḥ harī iti
ā tā vām nediṣṭham īmahe yuvāku hi śacīnām yuvāku
sadasaḥ patim adbhutam priyam indrasya kāmyam sanim medhām

column2: kāri ratnadhātamaḥ ye indrāya vacaḥyujā tatakṣuḥ manasā
upa idam savanam sutam indrāgnī iti iha gacchatām tā mahāntā
agne iha avase hotrām yaviṣṭha bhāratīm varūtrīm dhiṣaṇām vaha
ātatam tat viprāsaḥ vipanyavaḥ jāgṛvāṃsaḥ sam indhate
ṣṇuyā yat śubham yāthana naraḥ haskārāt vidyutaḥ pari
idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kim ca duḥitam mayi yat vā
yaḥ ārabhe nahi te kṣatram na sahaḥ na manyum vayaḥ cana
aheḷamānaḥ varuṇa iha bodhi uruśaṃsa mā naḥ
sya rīradhaḥ mā hṛṇānasya manyave vi mṛḷīkāya te manaḥ
bhrat drāpim hiraṇyayam varuṇaḥ vasta niḥnijam pari spaśaḥ
āpaye sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ ā naḥ barhiḥ riśādasaḥ
martyāt aghayoḥ pāhi sadam it viśvaāyuḥ imam
mahatbhyaḥ namaḥ arbhakebhyaḥ namaḥ namaḥ yuvabhyaḥ namaḥ

vaḥ śatakrato iti śatakrato ā kāmam jaritṝṇām
vrate kavayaḥ vidmanāapasaḥ ajāyanta marutaḥ
martam dadhāsi śravase divedive yaḥ tatṛṣāṇaḥ ubhayāya janmane
gāya catuḥakṣaḥ idhyase yaḥ rātahavyaḥ avṛkāya dhāyase
vājavatyā indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocam yāni cakāra
pipiṣe indraśatruḥ apāt ahastaḥ apṛtanyat indram ā
yat tvā pratiahan devaḥ ekaḥ ajayaḥ gāḥ ajayaḥ śūra
tāmi indram namasyan upamebhiḥ arkaiḥ yaḥ stotṛbhyaḥ
vyāḥ hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ na hinvānāsaḥ
matim atirat śāśadānaḥ āvaḥ kutsam indra yasmin
anuvrate jane triḥ supraavye tredhāiva śikṣatam triḥ nāndyam
rāsabhasya yena yajñam nāsatyā upayāthaḥ ā nāsatyā gacchatam
bhyām ā devaḥ yāti savitā parāvataḥ apa viśvā
dadhat ratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā
viśvavedasam mahaḥ te sataḥ vi caranti arcayaḥ divi
iha yajiṣṭham havyavāhana yam kaṇvaḥ medhyaatithiḥ
yaḥ asmadhruk yaḥ martyaḥ śiśīte ati aktubhiḥ mā
rdhāya ghṛṣvaye tveṣadyumnāya śuṣmiṇe devattam brahma gāyata
vaḥ duvaḥ tatro iti mādayādhvai asti hi madāya vaḥ
nāt marutām viśvam ā sadma pārthivam arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ
dyavi na bhūmyām riśādasaḥ tanā yujā rudrāsaḥ nu cit
ṇaḥ pate devayantaḥ tvā īmahe upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānavaḥ
kṣatram pṛñcīta hanti rājabhiḥ bhaye cit sukṣitim dadhe
vi aṃhaḥ vimucaḥ napāt sakṣva deva pra naḥ puraḥ yaḥ naḥ
thā naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ yathā rudraḥ ciketati yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ
yaviṣṭham atithim suāhutam juṣṭam janāya dāśuṣe devān
pracetasam jīram dūtam amartyam yat devānām mitramahaḥ puraḥhitaḥ
ciḥkeśam purupriya agne havyāya voḷhave ni tvā hotāram
yā naḥ pīparat aśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamaḥ tiraḥ tām
